TURN_TOKEN_ID.description: Paste the 32-character TURN Token ID shown in Cloudflare Realtime.

TURN_API_TOKEN.description: Paste the TURN API token shown once when you create your Cloudflare TURN key.

OWNER_KEY.description: Paste the private setup key generated by grow. Keep it secret.

ALLOWED_ORIGINS.description: Keep the grow address shown here, or add your own hosted frontend separated by commas.

RELAY_NAME.description: A friendly name friends will see before joining, such as Taylor’s private relay.
